conventions.Lw_change: chg_L(x)_t = x_t / x_{t-L} - 1 on complete weekly observations (L in complete observations: 13w = 13 obs, 52w = 52 obs)
conventions.alignment: each (anchor, shadow) rho is measured on the PAIRWISE overlap of their valid (post-warmup) observation sets; the overlap size is recorded per shadow; no re-windowing after seeing any number
conventions.ax2_as_of_macro: a macro observation dated d is AVAILABLE for decisions strictly after d+1 calendar day (conservative +1 day); the value used at decision t is the last observation with (obs_date + 1 day) <= t
conventions.kill_rule: ANY shadow pooled_rho > 0.20 => ANCESTRY_VETO, selection empty, cycle closes 0/3
conventions.pooled_rho: max(|weight-Pearson|, |weight-Spearman(midrank)|, |signal-rank-Spearman(midrank)|) via the M0 contract primary_comparisons; weights = sign(state) except the deterministic calendar shadows whose raw value IS both signal and sign state per the per-shadow spec
conventions.zscore_104: z(x)_t = (x_t - mean(trailing_104_complete_obs incl. t)) / std_population(trailing_104_complete_obs incl. t); undefined until 104 complete observations exist

feasibility_non_scored.cost_ceiling: band A 10bps/fill (P0 measured), 2 fills/rotation, ~52 rotations/yr => ~1,040bps/yr base; stress 2.0 => ~2,080bps/yr; pre-registered in plan F6 — never re-derived
feasibility_non_scored.decision_counts: total + per-fold weekly decision counts (folds per fold_freeze.json mapped to the weekly grid)
feasibility_non_scored.no_returns: D2 computes NO candidate returns/PnL/PF/Sharpe of the anchor anywhere
feasibility_non_scored.turnover: fraction of consecutive decision pairs where w changes (per arm)

grid.expected_size: 5,129 weekly-grid candidates collapse to 5,128 complete weekly observations... CORRECTION: 5,130 XNYS sessions / 5,129 sessions with all four symbols; weekly observations ~= 20 years x 52 - 1 skipped week, exact count recorded by the measurement run
grid.hole_handling: weeks failing the all-four rule yield NO observation (exactly one in-window: the ISO week containing 2008-11-28) — no imputation, no forward-fill; the anchor's book is SKIP-AND-HOLD across skipped decisions
grid.weekly_observation: an ISO week yields ONE observation iff all four symbols have an adjusted close at the week's LAST available session date that week; observation values are the four adjusted closes at that date

law: measured series MUST match these formulas exactly; any divergence => D2 INVALID/NOT_RUN, never PASS; thresholds immovable (0.20 pooled |rho|, M0 contract sha 8b5ee44b)
